note: Each entry names one case that skips on every job that selects it, and the reason that stops it. An entry names the case under `case`, or it names one class of skip under `skip_message_prefix`. tests/skip_gate.py reads this file and it fails an entry that names no reason. Repair a case rather than add an entry, unless a runner can never hold the condition the case needs. An entry that records an open finding names the issue that removes it. #530 added the one prefix entry, and it widened the gate to the ten reports of the five jobs that run cases.
measurement: The census of #524 measured every case entry below on 2026-08-10, in run https://github.com/Crank-Git/ja4plus/actions/runs/31408763259.

entries.reason: A cell of the conformance cross product reports this message where the vector holds no value for the method and ja4plus produces none. #530 measured 143 such cases on 2026-08-10. All 143 belong to `tests.test_spec_validation::test_the_produced_occurrence_keys_equal_the_reference`, which ran 199 other parameter sets in the same job. The function therefore asserts, and no case runs nowhere. A pass in place of the skip would assert an equality over two empty sets, which #524 put out of scope. The gate covers a case under this entry only where every report that skips it states this same prefix.
